From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly leadership traffic lights & action map

Team —

Quick leadership update for this week; attaching a compact ‘traffic lights’ workbook (traffic_lights_20280723.xlsx) and an updated QBR checklist (qbr_checklist_v2.docx). High-level: wins, top risks, and three asks.

Wins
- Production: 12% median p99 reduction on hosted text-gen after kernel tweak and batching change; latency SLOs now being met for most 1–2k token requests.
- Sales: Closed pilot terms with Acorn Analytics (see attached acorn_mop_signed.pdf). Pilot starts Aug 15; expected Dedicated usage spike in Sept.
- Ops: New tracing hook enabled in Console; token-level cost breakdown now available in beta for a subset of customers.

Top risks
- EU capacity: Dedicated pool provisioning for EU region is delayed by a week (vendor GPU allocation); potential throttling for Acorn pilot if not resolved.
- Model quality: Recent quantization profile for model-x-13b shows small regressions on multi-turn summarization in internal evals — risk for product demos.
- QBR readiness: Some teams missing finalized decks (deadline Wed EOD).

Asks
- Laura: approve a one-week emergency EU burst purchase (estimated $48k) to cover pilot ramp if vendor delay persists. Approve by Tue EOD?
- Jonas: prioritize a rollback plan for model-x-13b quantization by tomorrow so CS can demo stable model variants to Acorn.
- Marissa: confirm slide owners and IM the QBR deck tracker; I’ll consolidate Thurs morning.

Action map attached (traffic_lights_20280723.xlsx) with color-coded owners. I’ll follow up with a short digest for the Exec call.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
